item.title: Iranian Bishop of Chelmsford denounces 'unjust and illegal' war
item.description: The Bishop of Chelmsford, who fled from Iran as a teenager, has denounced the US-Israeli attack on the country as “unjust and illegal”.

item.title: BBC ignorant of religion, says Archbishop of York
item.description: The BBC suffers from an “appalling lack of religious literacy”, the Archbishop of York, Stephen Cottrell, has said.

item.title: British court rejects Ukrainian extradition for Church supporter
item.description: A British court has rejected an extradition request by the Ukrainian government for a supporter of the Ukrainian Orthodox Church.

item.title: Assisted suicide is wrong but even more so in a care crisis
item.description: For all the cries of care and compassion, a significant number of people exist who want to see this Bill become law for truly grotesque and utilitarian reasons. We cannot let them win.

item.title: Orthodox Anglicans pursue path of 'principled disengagement' from Canterbury-led Communion
item.description: The Gafcon movement has declared itself to be the true Anglican Communion as it continues its shift away from the historic instruments of communion under the spiritual leadership of the Archbishop of Canterbury.

item.title: Plymouth hosts Knife Angel as city churches unite for 28 days of prayer for peace
item.description: The Knife Angel is created from more than 100,000 knives and blades surrendered to police forces across the United Kingdom.

item.title: Iraqi Christian complex hit by suspected Iranian drone attack
item.description: A local church leader said the latest Middle East conflict would once again prompt the region's Christians to ask themselves whether they should stay or go.

item.title: Poll finds majority support legal protection for unborn babies with heartbeat
item.description: A pro-life organisation is urging the UK government to introduce new legal protections for unborn babies with detectable heartbeats.

item.title: UN rights panel hears concerns about discrimination against Christians in Europe
item.description: Christians in Europe are threatened by Islamist violence and government restrictions.

item.title: Concerns raised that government grooming gang inquiry will ignore Islam
item.description: "I grew up a Christian .. it was just used as a way to break me down, as in ‘Where is your God now? Why has your God forsaken you?” said one rape gang survivor.
